additionalDocuments.label: Ellington La Mer villa original project brief (DRE Homes mirror)

review.gallery: Eight project-specific renders from Ellington’s La Mer listing and one December 2025 photo from the developer construction gallery. The project’s full exterior render leads the card and gallery. The raw construction photo records a dated milestone. No finished villa photograph was verified.
review.location: The developer’s original map identifies the villa on the Jumeirah 1 waterfront. The House Finder and Madena project records share the approximate point. Four travel times are secondary broker estimates. The brochure gives landmark positions without a time table.
review.floorPlans: Four complete floor drawings from the original standalone PDF mirrored by Madena. The Ellington project brief repeats the set and contains an alternate ground-floor room label: driver room in the brief, prayer room in the standalone sheet. Both ground-floor sheets are available separately. The brief’s 33,044 sq ft villa and 21,934 sq ft plot figures apply to the whole property. The other repeated levels are represented by one drawing each.

unavailable: Exact visitor entrance, developer drive times, individual floor areas, applicable final revision and verified finished villa photographs.
